errors.text_span: Няма числови единици, тъй като осите са в проценти.
errors.evidence: This sentence is confusing and inaccurate. The x-axis represents years, which are numbers, so it does have numerical labels. The statement that both axes ('осите') are in percentages is incorrect; only the y-axis is.

errors.evidence: The description for 'ОББ вкл. СИБ' incorrectly states that the line has circular markers and is dotted ('пунктирана'). The plot shows the markers are 'x'-shaped and the line is solid.

errors.text_span: след което се възстановява и се стабилизира около 60–70% до 2015 г.
errors.evidence: In the description for 'ОББ вкл. СИБ', the period until 2015 is described as stabilizing around 60-70%. This is a major misrepresentation, as the line shows extreme volatility, including a massive spike to over 100% in 2012, which is the most prominent feature of this line in that period.

errors.text_span: има леко възходящ тренд до 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The description for 'ОББ вкл. СИБ' describes the trend up to 2017 as 'a slight upward trend'. This completely misses the second massive spike to over 100% that occurs in 2017.

The description misses the most prominent visual features of the chart, namely the two extreme peaks of the 'ОББ вкл. СИБ' line which both go above 100% in 2012 and 2017. It also misses the high peak of the 'Пощенска банка' line, which approaches 90% in 2012.
In the description for 'Пощенска банка', the value is said to drop to around 40% in 2016. The plot shows the value is closer to 45%.
